description: Source code for managing remote clusters and plugin registration in Mattermost, including functions for registering, unregistering, updating, deleting, and handling remote cluster invites.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for remote cluster and plugin management.

methods.name: RegisterPluginForSharedChannels
methods.description: Registers or updates a plugin for shared channels, managing remote cluster entries and pinging the remote service if available.

methods.name: UnregisterPluginForSharedChannels
methods.description: Unregisters a plugin from shared channels by deleting its remote cluster entry.

methods.name: AddRemoteCluster
methods.description: Adds a new remote cluster entry to the store, handling uniqueness constraints.

methods.name: PatchRemoteCluster
methods.description: Applies a patch to an existing remote cluster.

methods.name: UpdateRemoteCluster
methods.description: Updates an existing remote cluster entry in the store.

methods.name: DeleteRemoteCluster
methods.description: Deletes a remote cluster by ID.

methods.name: GetRemoteCluster
methods.description: Retrieves a remote cluster by ID, with optional inclusion of deleted entries.

methods.name: GetAllRemoteClusters
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of remote clusters based on filter criteria.

methods.name: UpdateRemoteClusterTopics
methods.description: Updates topics associated with a remote cluster.

methods.name: SetRemoteClusterLastPingAt
methods.description: Updates the last ping timestamp for a remote cluster.

methods.name: GetRemoteClusterService
methods.description: Retrieves the remote cluster service interface if enabled.

methods.name: CreateRemoteClusterInvite
methods.description: Creates an encrypted invite code for remote cluster connection.

methods.name: DecryptRemoteClusterInvite
methods.description: Decrypts an invite code to retrieve remote cluster invite details.
